【CONT】 During the attack phase, you cannot return characters from your waiting room to your hand by your cards' effects.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, if this card is on the middle position of your center stage, move this card to an open position of your center stage.

cards.name: "Close to Tears" Aqua
cards.text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put 2 cards from the top of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Adventurer》 or 《Goddess》 characters among those cards ×1000.

cards.name: "Burn to Nothingness" Sylvia
cards.text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
【CONT】 All of your other  《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name get +1000 power.
【ACT】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] Choose 1 of your  《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name, and that character gets +2500 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: "Menacing Pose" Aqua
cards.text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck."

cards.name: "Discerning Eyes" Sylvia
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other  《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name you have ×1000.

cards.text: Choose 1 of your 【STAND】 《Devil King Army》characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name, and 【REST】 it. If you do, search your deck for up to 1  《Devil King Army》 character or character with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your deck, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
